ai_summary: Ador Welding Limited reported robust financial performance for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, with net profit and earnings per share more than doubling compared to the prior year, alongside the declaration of an interim dividend of Rs. 7.50 per share. Despite strong profitability, operating cash flow significantly declined due to increased working capital requirements, notably a substantial reduction in trade payables, leading to a material increase in short-term borrowings to fund operations and shareholder distributions.
